utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that so? You’re sure it’s picking up nicely?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, definitely — I saw a few more neighbors come by with boxes just this morning. There’s still room for a few more hands if you’re thinking of helping.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what still needs doing. If you want, I can let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, that’d be helpful — I might’ve missed what’s left to do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll swing by later, check what’s still needed, and let you know. If I spot anything urgent, I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m ready to help—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start with the broken fence panel by the side yard—it’s the biggest hassle right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll grab the tools and take a look at that fence panel first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you’re putting the repair drive together—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we still need a few supplies, mainly tape, a couple of screwdrivers, and some heavy-duty gloves. If you can grab any of that, it’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can pick up the tape and gloves today, and I’ll see if I have an extra screwdriver too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule if that makes the repair drive easier. What timing are you aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would help a lot, thanks. I’m aiming for a Saturday morning start so folks can still make afternoon plans.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works well for me—I can help keep it clear of school conflicts. What time were you thinking for the start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive, if you’ve got one. Let me know what needs doing and when.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, when you want to start, and who’s coordinating. I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling a few folks about the repair drive now—do you want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe put me down as a maybe for now—I need to check my schedule and see what tools I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mark you as a maybe and keep you in the loop. Just let me know when you’ve checked your schedule and tools!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re lining up the volunteer list and confirming the first few repair jobs now. I’ll share the schedule as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m glad it’s moving along. Just let me know when the schedule’s ready and I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive is for?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Saturday at 10 a.m., and it’s for small home repairs like leaky faucets, loose doors, and minor electrical fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll note Saturday at 10 a.m. for small home repairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’m keeping things pretty low-key right now. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it low-key too. I could use you to help sort the repair list and point me to anything urgent.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. Send me the list, and I’ll flag anything urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a wrench and some duct tape I could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — I can bring them over հիմա. Just give me a minute and I’ll drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the repair drive is at the community center parking lot, near the back entrance. If you want, I can double-check the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — that’d help. I’ll head to the community center parking lot and look near the back entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll double-check and let you know if it’s tucked somewhere else nearby.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate it — I’ll let you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — just give me a shout when you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need to know the exact drop-off time and what items they’re accepting so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, that makes sense — can you confirm the exact drop-off time and the list of accepted items? I don’t want to guess and get it wrong.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I need the official details first so I don’t pass along the wrong time or list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help get folks coordinated for the repair drive—want me to reach out and see who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please do — that would be a huge help. Let me know who’s available, and I’ll keep track from here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and send you a quick list of who can help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I’m a little late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re doing all right—still collecting supplies, and a few folks dropped things off this morning. If you’ve got anything to spare, bring it by and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already. If you’ve got anything that needs fixing, I’d say now’s the time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’ve got a couple of little things at home, so I may bring them by after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh nice, that’ll be perfect. I’d bring them while the volunteers are still fresh and the line’s not too long.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m in—just give me the quick version of the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — quick version: we’re gathering neighbors for small home repairs, matching people to helpers, and making a list of what each place needs. If you’re in, I can put you down and send the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, put me down. Send the details and I’ll skim it later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort and load the donated items this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help sort and load the donated items this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m going to start spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to invite everyone on the block?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, please do — I’m still hearing about it secondhand, so that would really help. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let the whole block know right away. If you want, I can also put up a quick note by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep track of the repair drive location and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Just let me know the exact spot and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll confirm the exact spot and send it your way as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but let me double-check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — can you check and let me know by tonight?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. If you hear anything, just let me know.
